resources.string: Stream a PC screen from Sunshine or Apollo. Type the PC\'s address, then pair.
Paired. Connect to stream the PC\'s screen.
PC address, like 192.168.1.20 (add :port for a second Apollo)
That address isn\'t right. Type it like 192.168.1.20, or 192.168.1.20:48989 with a port.
Paired with %1$s. PC screen %2$d uses the same host, and a host streams one screen at a time. For both at once, run Pocket XR\'s \"Set up PC screens\" on the PC once, then tap Forget this PC here.
Pairing with %1$s… If your PC asks, click Yes there.
Click Yes on %1$s to let Pocket XR use it.
With the Pocket XR PC helper on your PC, there is no PIN to type: tap Set up my PC.
Looking for the Pocket XR PC helper on your PC…
Your PC needs the Pocket XR PC helper once. Send yourself the link, open it on the PC, run the helper, then tap Set up my PC again.
Open this on your PC and run the Pocket XR PC helper: %1$s
Click Yes on %1$s to set up PC screens.
Setup is running on %1$s: answer its questions there. Then tap your PC above.
%1$s did not say yes. Tap Set up my PC to ask again.
Use this phone at home to wake your PC from away

A sleeping PC can only be woken from its own home network. Leave this phone at home on the Wi-Fi, plugged in, with this switched on and Tailscale on (signed in to the same account as your PC and your other phone). Then Pocket XR on your other phone wakes the PC through it from anywhere. Open a PC screen on your other phone once at home so it finds this phone.
Tailscale is on (%1$s), so it works from away.
Tailscale is off on this phone: turn it on, or the relay only works at home.
Let it run in the background
Battery saving may stop it: tap Let it run in the background, find Pocket XR and choose Don\'t optimise (or Unrestricted).
Away from home? Install Tailscale on this phone and sign in with the same account as the PC. On the PC, run Set up PC screens and say yes to using it away from home.
Away from home? Turn on Tailscale on this phone (tap Away from home below), then tap Connect.
Tailscale is on. Check the PC is awake and signed in to Tailscale with the same account.
Lost the connection to the PC. Tap Connect when it\'s back.
Forgotten. Tap a PC to set this screen up again.
Looking for PCs on your Wi-Fi…
No PC found yet. Check Apollo is running on the PC and the PC is on the same Wi-Fi as the phone. You can also type its address below.
PC screen %1$d already uses that one. Tap another, or run Set up PC screens on the PC to add more.
Can\'t reach %1$s. Check the PC is on, Apollo is running, and the PC and phone are on the same Wi-Fi.
Apollo is blocking this phone. On the PC, open %1$s, go to Clients, and turn on Launch apps, Mouse and Keyboard for this phone. Then tap Connect.
The PC no longer knows this phone. Tap your PC above to pair again.
Enter PIN %1$s on the PC, in Sunshine\'s or Apollo\'s web page (PIN tab). Apollo: then give this device the Launch apps, mouse and keyboard permissions there.
Paired with %1$s. Connect to stream its screen.
